description: Site-wide horizontal navigation. The first pattern every landing / docs / dashboard surface needs: logo (left), primary nav (middle/right), action cluster (right). One row, sticky to the top, semi-transparent backdrop blur so content scrolls visibly…

docs:
## @interlace/topbar

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/topbar.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/topbar';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/topbar

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
